entry_item.definition: n. and adj. Artisan, craftsman; person free from taxes and official duties; area or place set aside for religious reasons and therefore inviolable; sacred; great, celebrated (cf. darxad).

example.definition: A sacred mountain (where hunting and lumber working are not permitted).
The rank and privileges of a peerage; the status of darxan; famous or celebrated name.
Retired high officials who enjoy certain privileges
